posts.text: Hello all, As per mgmt. latest Q1FY27 guidance with Rev growth few bps higher than FY26 revenue (which is 21%), Possibly they could exceed the Rev growth of FY23 with NPM of 14~15%. I have been in this stock from its downfall and its good mgmt.with under commitment and over delivery type with prudent cash allocation. Having this, how exit can be planned in this scrip? Industry they are in is cyclical in nature. is it good to exit after FY27 performance? How is growth in next year as per your view? Please share your thoughts regarding this.
